{
  "name": "pet",
  "version": "0.6.4",
  "description": "A little companion on the Windows desktop, always on top: a cardboard box or one of twelve figures (cat, dog, fox, bunny, hamster, owl, penguin, frog, axolotl, dragon, robot, ghost; cat, dog and bunny in nine coats). It says in a speech bubble what Claude is doing, shows permission requests, and lets you click Claude's questions and Next Steps' suggestions right in the bubble. Drag it anywhere; right-click for quiet time or another figure; optionally one pet per session, each with its own figure. Built once with the C# compiler that ships with Windows and signed with the Sign Guard script when one is set. /pet shows it, /pet cat calico picks a figure, /pet stop sends it off.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Lupus Malus Deviant"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/LupusMalusDeviant/claude-mods/tree/main/plugins/pet",
  "types": "./mods/pet/types/contract.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "bubble": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "9",
      "options": [
        "5",
        "9",
        "15",
        "30"
      ],
      "title": "Desktop Pet: bubble stays … seconds",
      "description": "How long news stays in the bubble. Questions and errors stay until the next news."
    },
    "summary": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "haiku"
      ],
      "title": "Desktop Pet: summary at the end",
      "description": "off: the first sentences of the answer (no tokens). haiku: Haiku sums up a longer answer in up to three short sentences (what was done, what is open). A click on the pet shows the last answer in short either way."
    },
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "box",
      "options": [
        "box",
        "cat",
        "dog",
        "fox",
        "bunny",
        "hamster",
        "owl",
        "penguin",
        "frog",
        "axolotl",
        "dragon",
        "robot",
        "ghost",
        "random"
      ],
      "title": "Desktop Pet: figure",
      "description": "Who stands on the desktop. random: a different one each session. /pet cat calico switches it too."
    },
    "fur": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "ginger",
        "black",
        "white",
        "grey",
        "brown",
        "cream",
        "calico",
        "siamese",
        "tuxedo",
        "random"
      ],
      "title": "Desktop Pet: coat (cat, dog, bunny)",
      "description": "The coat colour of cat, dog and bunny."
    },
    "perSession": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "on"
      ],
      "title": "Desktop Pet: one pet per active session",
      "description": "on: every session whose prompt cache is warm has its own pet, side by side, each with its own figure (/pet or the right-click menu). When a session's cache goes cold its pet goes to sleep; the next message brings it back. off: one pet for all."
    },
    "cacheWarn": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "5",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "2",
        "5",
        "10"
      ],
      "title": "Desktop Pet: warn before the cache goes cold (minutes)",
      "description": "That many minutes before the prompt cache expires the pet says so, with a button that keeps it warm for an hour (Cache Meter on). Not while keep-warm runs."
    },
    "ask": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ],
      "title": "Desktop Pet: answer Claude's questions",
      "description": "Claude's questions (AskUserQuestion) appear as buttons in the bubble too; the first answer counts, the pet's or the dialog's."
    },
    "remind": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "60",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "30",
        "60",
        "120"
      ],
      "title": "Desktop Pet: show a hidden question again (seconds)",
      "description": "A question still open whose bubble you hid (double-click, menu) comes back after that many seconds. Not while the pet is snoozed."
    },
    "suggest": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ],
      "title": "Desktop Pet: suggestions and reply buttons",
      "description": "With Next Steps on, its suggestions appear as buttons in the bubble. When an answer ends with a question to you, Haiku offers two or three short replies as buttons (a few tokens). A click sends one as your next prompt."
    },
    "permissions": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "show",
      "options": [
        "show",
        "answer"
      ],
      "title": "Desktop Pet: permission requests",
      "description": "show: the pet only says that Claude Code is waiting for your approval. answer: the bubble also offers \"allow once\" and \"deny\" for 90 seconds (never \"always\"; no rule is added). Mind that the pet stays on top: a click there approves."
    },
    "typing": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "on"
      ],
      "title": "Desktop Pet: type answers in the pet",
      "description": "on: a hotkey, the pet's menu or a button in the bubble opens a small input box; the text goes to Claude as the next prompt, as the answer to its open question, or in place of a suggestion. Typing takes the keyboard from the game for a moment (borderless windowed mode is fine). Any program of your user can write the pet's answer file, hence off by default."
    },
    "hotkey": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "ctrl+alt+space",
      "options": [
        "ctrl+alt+space",
        "ctrl+shift+space",
        "ctrl+alt+c",
        "off"
      ],
      "title": "Desktop Pet: hotkey for typing",
      "description": "Opens the input box from anywhere, also from a game. With several pets the first one gets it."
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Language of the texts this mod shows and writes.",
      "default": "en",
      "options": [
        "de",
        "en"
      ]
    },
    "signScript": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "",
      "title": "script",
      "description": "PowerShell script called as <script> -Exe <file>. Empty: ~/.claude/skills/sign-binary/sign.ps1"
    },
    "cacheTtl": {
      "type": "string",
      "default": "60",
      "options": [
        "60",
        "5"
      ],
      "title": "cache lifetime (minutes)",
      "description": "60 on a subscription (Pro/Max), 5 for the API's default cache."
    }
  }
}
